name: Ruen
title: Delfmaster
examine: Sixty years of reading stone. Her grandmother's name is on the names-stone, eleventh row. She runs the town like a good shift: everyone counted out, everyone counted back.
lines: Count your crew before the burn, not after.
The Crown never answers my letters. The mountain always answers my knock.
Grievances go in the shift book. Miracles too, if you have any.
